owner_calls.question: The box's code note says 'the bridge where Bucky meets him' (row 'Bucky: The Bridge'). On screen Cap is turned on the Golden Gate Bridge (bitten by zombie Hank Pym); Bucky meets and bisects him on the survivors' train out of Grand Central, heading to New Jersey. The row title is invented on purpose and is not flagged; is the note's premise meant to read 'the train where Bucky meets him', or is 'The Bridge' a deliberate nod to the Golden Gate?
options: Keep as is (the title nods to the Golden Gate Bridge where he is turned)
Reword only the code note to 'the train where Bucky meets him'
owner_calls.evidence: What If... Zombies?!: the Avengers land on the Golden Gate Bridge, where Rogers is bitten by a shrunken zombie Hank Pym; later zombie Rogers boards the train at Grand Central, infects Sharon Carter, and Bucky slices him in half with the shield, so he falls onto the track. In Marvel Zombies episode 1 he is in Wanda's horde at the North Institute and Alexei kills him.
